text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
Are these emotions... the tears of 
Persephone? No, the wrath of Demeter...

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text: Ghk, isn't there a more fitting phrase?!

text_block_list.name: Tanino Gimlet
text_block_list.text:
I should step away from the feast of 
Olympus for a moment. And read up on the 
saga of the warriors too—

Even after that, she stayed up late into 
the night... continually searching for 
cool phrases worthy of expressing her 
feelings.
